title: ACIS pending worklist logical-slot accounting fast slice
mode: local implementation and generated in-memory regression
scope: Account the ordered pending worklist entries retained alongside queued membership
Preserve breadth-first traversal, graph output order, and exact fail-closed output limits

changes.summary: Added one output-item charge before pending.push_back, after queued-set admission. The ordered vector and membership set each retain one logical slot per queued source index.

The generated two-lump cycle accepts maxOutputItems=33 with unchanged projection links and cycle count, and refuses at 32 with ResourceLimit and cleared output. Before the charge, the 32-item negative assertion failed because that incomplete budget was admitted.

evidence.redGreen: The 32-item refusal regression failed before accounting the pending vector slots and passed afterward.
